title: Air-Cooled V8 Engine Overhaul & Cylinder Head Torquing
description: Intermediate technical English module analyzing air-cooled v8 engine overhaul & cylinder head torquing.
learning_objectives: Master professional Past Continuous vs Past Simple in automotive engineering

questions.prompt: Before the prototype truck entered the test track, the test engineer noticed that the air suspension bellows pressure _____.

explanations.correct: Past Perfect Passive ('had been calibrated') is required because the action was completed prior to the past action 'noticed'.
explanations.wrong_A: Past Simple ('was calibrated') fails to indicate precedence before 'noticed'.
explanations.wrong_C: Present Perfect ('has been calibrated') cannot connect to a past anchor time.
explanations.wrong_D: 'didn't calibrate' is active voice, but mechanical parts are acted upon passively.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses simple past for both actions ('všiml si, že díl nebyl...'). In English engineering logs, use Past Perfect for sequence clarity.
